claims.content: The Auctioneer wants to configure the sitewide auction rules that govern defaults and settings for reserve tiers and bid increments, overtime bidding, shipping charges and promotions, preview periods, and post-close removals visibility.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Auctioneer wants to configure the sitewide auction rules that govern defaults and settings for reserve tiers and bid increments, overtime bidding, shipping charges and promotions, preview periods, and post-close removals visibility.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Auctioneer configures global auction rules using the Manage Global Settings Page across the supported settings sections.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Auctioneer begins configuring global auction rules in the Manage Global Settings Page.
scope_contract.success_boundary: Global auction rules are configured across the supported global settings sections.
in_scope_actions: Configure Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings
excluded_adjacent_actions: Scheduling auctions, selecting products, applying products to events, and scheduling timeframes
variant_dimensions: Reserve tier and bid increment defaults

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the system as an Auctioneer and can access the Auction Administration workspace.
The Auctioneer accesses the 'Manage Global Settings' page via the 'Administration Menu' link on the 'Auction Admin Main Menu Page'.

On the Manage Global Settings Page, the Auctioneer configures Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings by entering values for cost tiers, selecting opening bid options (Amount or % of Cost), and entering discrete full dollar amounts for bid increments.
As the Auctioneer enters cost tier values, the system automatically populates the low end of the next cost tier as the high end of the previous range plus $0.01.
The Auctioneer clicks Apply Changes to save the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment settings.
The Auctioneer configures Overtime Bidding by toggling the radio button to On or Off, entering a time extension duration between 10 seconds and 60 minutes, and clicking Apply Changes.

The Auctioneer configures Shipping Settings by entering values for sitewide first item shipping charge, sitewide subsequent items shipping charge, Preferred Customer revenue threshold, and New Per-Item Shipping Charge, then clicking Apply Changes.

The Auctioneer sets a temporary shipping promotion by entering starting and ending dates/times and a promotional shipping charge; the system validates that the dates are in the future, the end date is after the start date, and the promotion lasts no more than seven days; then the Auctioneer clicks Apply Changes.
The Auctioneer sets the Preview Period by entering hours and minutes, up to a maximum of 24 hours, and clicking Apply Changes.
The Auctioneer sets Post-Close Removals visibility duration by entering Hours and Minutes for how long closed auctions remain visible in browse results, then clicking Apply Changes.
The Auctioneer has applied changes for the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment, Overtime Bidding, Shipping, Preview Period, and Post-Close Removals settings.

missing_aspects: Evidence supports the individual actions of applying changes but does not explicitly support the cumulative summary claim that 'global auction rules' have been configured across those sections.

No evidence card describes a legal alternative path that diverges from a specific main-flow step while still achieving the same successful postcondition of configuring sitewide global auction rules on the Manage Global Settings Page.

Evidence about Event Profiles overriding Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings describes an adjacent configuration route rather than a legal divergence that still produces the same global-settings postcondition.

claims.content: Exception branch 6a (divergence at main-flow step 6): If the Auctioneer sets a temporary shipping promotion with dates that are not in the future, or with an ending date that is not after the start date, validation fails and the system prevents the promotion from being set.

Exception branch 6b (divergence at main-flow step 6): If the Auctioneer attempts to configure a temporary shipping promotion that lasts for more than seven days, validation fails and the system prevents the promotion from being set.

Exception branch 1a (divergence at main-flow step 1): If the Auctioneer enters a '% of Cost' value under 100% for an opening bid reserve tier, the system displays the value in BOLD RED as a warning but does not prevent the Auctioneer from proceeding with the configuration. Exit: the Auctioneer may continue configuring with the warning displayed.

claims.content: The configured global auction rules are saved and applied immediately as the new sitewide defaults across the supported settings sections: Reserve Tier and Bid Increment, Overtime Bidding, Shipping, Preview Period, and Post-Close Removals.

The configured reserve cost tiers, with their corresponding reserve (opening bid) amounts and discrete full dollar bid increments, are saved and active as sitewide defaults for all items in those tiers unless overridden by Event Profiles.

The configured sitewide first-item shipping charge, subsequent-items shipping charge, Preferred Customer revenue threshold, and New Per-Item Shipping Charge are persisted and active for future transactions.

The configured Post-Close Removals visibility rule is active: closed auctions are removed immediately from the site's category pages after closing and appear on the Recently-ended page for a fixed period of 24 hours.

missing_aspects: Persistence and activation of a configured temporary shipping promotion are not documented.
Explicit postcondition behavior for Overtime Bidding and Preview Period settings beyond being saved/applied as sitewide defaults is not documented.
